en: {player}! Hey! Dad told me you saved him. And he gave you a Pokémon? That's so cool!
text: {player}! Hei! Tata mi-a spus că l-ai salvat. Și ți-a dat un Pokémon? Ce tare!

en: I was just counting the Pokémon around here. But I've got my own partner too, you know.
text: Tocmai număram Pokémonii de pe aici. Dar să știi că am și eu un partener.

en: Let's have a battle! I'll show you what being a trainer is all about!
text: Hai să ne luptăm! O să-ți arăt ce înseamnă să fii Antrenor!

en: Wow... You're really good! I can see why your Pokémon trusts you, {player}.
text: Uau... Chiar te pricepi! Înțeleg de ce are Pokémonul tău încredere în tine, {player}.

en: I think I've seen enough for today. I'm heading back to the lab. Come on, Dad will want to hear about this!
text: Cred că am văzut destule pe azi. Mă întorc la laborator. Hai, tata o să vrea să audă de asta!

en: Hm? A Champion, out here? Then you'll want to see this. There's a hollow behind this rock wall. I can hear the wind in it.
Hup! Hah! ... There! I knocked the rock away. That's Altering Cave.
Funny place. The Pokémon in it are never the same two days running. Nobody knows why.
Altering Cave's Pokémon change from day to day. Come back often and you'll meet all sorts!
